observations: Locally fabricated industrial machine with a grey base and black hopper.

No electric motor, combustion engine, or drive belts are mounted on the machine frame.
A sign in photo 0 identifies the fabricator as 'STARDOM CONST. COMPANY NIG.' with phone numbers.
The machine is positioned on wooden blocks on a dirt floor in a workshop environment.
A larger, red-painted machine of similar design is visible in the background of photo 0.
The hopper opening is wide, consistent with plastic bottle intake.
